data.name: Sheraton Buganvilias Puerto Vallarta
data.address: Blvd. Francisco Medina Ascencio 999, Zona Hotelera, Las Glorias, 48333 Puerto Vallarta, Jal., Mexico
data.description:
On a beach along the Pacific Coast, this modern, upscale hotel is 1 km from the Malecón boardwalk, and 7 km from the Vallarta Undersea scuba diving school.
Minimalist rooms offer Wi-Fi (fee), flat-screen TVs, and coffeemakers; some add terraces with garden views. Upgraded rooms offer views of the bay and/or the ocean and surrounding mountains, as well as butler service and an exclusive lounge. Room service is available.
Parking is free. Pools offer swim-up bars, waterfalls, and a hot tub. Dining options include seafood and Italian fare. There’s also a tequila bar. Other amenities include a fitness center, tennis courts and a spa.
